name: cx-goal-many-rules
task: Move the ball away from the door before you take the key. Try not to drop the key while the door is still closed. Whenever you are holding the key, try to have the door open at that moment or open it afterwards. Then pick up the box in the other room.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: Existence(target_picked_up) covers the commanded 'pick up the box'; Precedence(blocker_moved, has_door_key) matches 'move the ball before you take the key'; soft Absence(key_lost) matches 'try not to drop the key while the door is still closed' (key_lost already encodes the closed-door condition); soft Response(has_door_key, door_open) matches 'whenever you are holding the key, try to have the door open at that moment or open it afterwards'.

texts: blocker_moved must happen before has_door_key happens
Never key_lost while door is closed
Whenever has_door_key holds, door_open must hold at that moment or afterwards
Eventually pick up the target box
